Subject: Supply chain assurance package request — Redwood Inference

Hi Markus,

Thanks for taking this. TrustBridge is kicking off a routine supplier assurance for our new vendor tiering. For our records we need the following items from Redwood for our security review (SOC 2 / CAIQ focus):

- Full subprocessor inventory (current as-of date) with locations and contract start dates.
- Copies of or redacted excerpts from vendor contracts demonstrating security/data processing clauses.
- SOC 2 Type II report (redacted allowed) or equivalent audit evidence.
- CAIQ responses or a completed CAIQ spreadsheet.
- A high-level dataflow diagram showing where customer data leaves Redwood and which subprocessors see plaintext.
- KMS/HSM usage summary (who manages keys, BYOK support, HSM vendor).
- Any attestation your Legal or Security team can sign for subcontractor oversight and onboarding process.

Can you confirm whether you can provide these within five business days and preferred file formats (PDF/CSV/PNG)? Also let us know if you require an NDA or secure upload link.

Best,
Pam
Risk Analyst
TrustBridge Security

Pam,

Thanks — attaching the requested package. Summary below and quick notes inline.

Attachments included:
- RBW_Subprocessor_Attestation_20260322.pdf (signed by Evelyn Hart, Deputy GC) — attests to our onboarding, continuous monitoring cadence, and subcontractor obligations.
- subprocessors_20260322.csv (as provided earlier) — includes contract_start and country.
- SOC2_report_redacted.pdf — redacted SOC 2 Type II (control mappings redacted for customer-specific info).
- CAIQ_responses_20260322.xlsx — CAIQ completed for vendor-related sections.
- dataflow_v1.png — high-level diagram marking which subprocessors see plaintext.

Quick answers to your follow-ups:
1) Contract clauses: Evelyn attached redacted excerpts mapped to TrustBridge items (see attestation PDF appendix). Standard breach notification: 72 hours after confirmed incident affecting customer data.
2) KMS/BYOK: For hosted customers Redwood manages encryption keys in cloud KMS; customers on Dedicated/Private can opt for BYOK where they maintain sole key custody (we support Thales HSM integrations). Key rotation policy: 90-day key rotation for intermediate keys; master keys rotated only with customer consent in BYOK scenarios. See kms-summary.txt (attached previously) and the attestation.
3) CAIQ: completed for all subprocessor and vendor-management questions in the XLSX; flagged a couple of answers where the control is provided by the cloud provider and noted in comments.

If you prefer, we can push these files to your secure SFTP or a redact-enabled drive. Let me know where to send and we’ll transfer the originals (the SOC2 report contains sensitive audit attachments).

Thanks for the quick turnaround — happy to hop on a 30-min call if you want to walk through specifics.

-Markus

Redwood Inference
